children: US subsidiary Welspun Tubular secures its largest HFIW pipe contract, lifting the company’s global order book to a record Rs 45,000 crore

Welspun Corp’s wholly owned US subsidiary Welspun Tubular LLC has secured its largest-ever order for High-Frequency Induction Welded (HFIW) pipes, valued at approximately Rs 4,000 crore, with the contract set to be executed during FY28 and FY29.
The order, worth around USD 412.5 million, will be manufactured at the company’s upgraded HFIW mill in Little Rock, US, and takes Welspun Corp’s global order book to a record Rs 45,000 crore.

The company said the contract is its largest in terms of volume, length and value. The order will be executed at Welspun Tubular’s newly upgraded HFIW facility in Little Rock, which has enhanced manufacturing capabilities.

The latest contract strengthens Welspun Corp’s manufacturing presence in the US and provides additional capacity for executing large international pipe orders. The company has been expanding its overseas manufacturing footprint as it seeks to build relationships with international customers and increase its participation in global infrastructure and energy projects.
Following the contract win, Welspun Corp’s global order book has reached USD 4.7 billion, equivalent to approximately Rs 45,000 crore, marking the highest level in the company’s history.

The company said the order reflects the scale and execution capabilities of its operations while supporting its strategy of expanding global manufacturing capacity and strengthening relationships with international customers.

The development comes shortly after Welspun Corp’s Saudi associate East Pipes Integrated Company for Industry secured a steel pipe contract worth more than 771 million Saudi riyals from Saudi Arabian Oil Company, or Saudi Aramco. The contract was valued at around Rs 2,000 crore, including value-added tax.

Welspun Corp manufactures and supplies pipe products for infrastructure and energy applications across international markets. The company’s latest US order is scheduled for execution in FY28 and FY29, providing visibility for production at its Little Rock facility over the period.
Welspun Corp stock traded at Rs 2,786 with 3.48 per cent gain on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) in the afternoon session.
